def collect_active_users(users, cutoff)
  users.each_with_object([]) do |user, active|
    next unless user.online? && user.last_seen_at > cutoff

    active << user.name
  end
end

def group_posts_by_tag(posts)
  posts.each_with_object(Hash.new { |hash, key| hash[key] = [] }) do |post, grouped|
    post.tags.each do |tag|
      grouped[tag] << post.slug
    end
  end
end

def build_summary(project)
  raise ArgumentError, "missing project name" if project.name.blank?

  summary = "#{project.name}:#{project.branch}".downcase
  summary.tr(" ", "-")
end

def clamp_score(score, range)
  return range.min if score < range.min
  return range.max if score > range.max

  score
end

clamped = clamp_score(120, 0..100)

def fetch_with_retry(url, attempts: 3)
  attempt = 0

  begin
    attempt += 1
    HTTP.get(url).tap { |response| raise "bad status" unless response.status.success? }
  rescue StandardError => error
    retry if attempt < attempts
    raise error
  end
end

module Memoizable
  def memoize(method_name)
    original = instance_method(method_name)
    cache = {}

    define_method(method_name) do |*args|
      cache[args] ||= original.bind(self).call(*args)
    end
  end
end

def index_by(items)
  items.each_with_object({}) do |item, indexed|
    key = yield(item)
    indexed[key] = item
  end
end

users_by_id = index_by(users) { |user| user.id }
